preview.assumptions_explanation: ASSUMPTIONS: Model Qwen 2.5 3B (37 layers total: 36 transformer blocks + 1 output layer). Cost per layer at n_ctx=2048: ~94 MiB (73 MiB weights [Q4_K_M] + ~16 MiB KV cache + ~2 MiB compute buffer). Headroom reserved: 512 MB RAM, 256 MB VRAM. INACCURACY CONDITIONS: 1) Non-Q4 quantizations (Q8_0 adds ~42 MiB/layer; FP16 adds ~102 MiB/layer); 2) Extended context lengths (KV cache expands to 64 MiB/layer at 8k ctx, 256 MiB/layer at 32k ctx); 3) Multi-sequence concurrent batches; 4) CUDA runtime driver overhead (~250-500 MB VRAM) and DWM display composition; 5) RPC network socket non-paged pool memory. CONTROL ENFORCEMENT: Device memory budgets (SWARM_WORKER_PROFILES) are advisory targets used to calculate proportional tensor splits (model_params.tensor_split), NOT hard OS memory caps. The only genuinely hard-enforced control is endpoint exclusion from SWARM_RPC_ENDPOINTS.
